import warnings
from fastapi.responses import UJSONResponse, ORJSONResponse
import pytest

def test_ujson_response_deprecation():
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
        warnings.simplefilter("always")
        UJSONResponse({"foo": "bar"})
        assert len(w) == 1
        assert "UJSONResponse is deprecated" in str(w[-1].message)

def test_orjson_response_deprecation():
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
        warnings.simplefilter("always")
        ORJSONResponse({"foo": "bar"})
        assert len(w) == 1
        assert "ORJSONResponse is deprecated" in str(w[-1].message)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        test_ujson_response_deprecation()
        print("UJSONResponse deprecation test passed")
        test_orjson_response_deprecation()
        print("ORJSONResponse deprecation test passed")
    except Exception as e:

        exit(1)
